rationale: The structure that justified entry is intact — twenty consecutive 1-minute bars have held 31.91+ with zero give-back, price sits in the top 7% of the day's range above rising VWAP (31.82) and the 9-EMA (31.85) while SPY is down 0.78%, which reads as absorption rather than distribution on 48x relative volume. The $31.70 invalidation is untouched and caps remaining risk at roughly $130 against $549 of budget, so there is no mechanical reason to scratch out at +0.11%; the honest caveat is that the volume surge that triggered the entry has dried up and the flag hasn't expanded in 31 minutes, keeping conviction only modest. Flipping short has no support — it would mean shorting strength above VWAP in a tight coil on a gap runner.
